verses.text: A Psalm. Sing to YHWH a new song, for He has done wonders! His right hand has gained victory for Him, even the arm of His holiness.

segments.text: A Psalm. Sing to YHWH a new song, for He has done wonders! His right hand has gained victory for Him, even the arm of His holiness.

verses.text: YHWH has made known His victory; before the eyes of the nations, He has revealed His righteousness.

segments.text: YHWH has made known His victory; before the eyes of the nations, He has revealed His righteousness.

verses.text: He has remembered His kindness and His faithfulness to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the victory of our God.

segments.text: He has remembered His kindness and His faithfulness to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the victory of our God.

verses.text: Shout joyfully to YHWH, all the earth; break forth and cry aloud and sing praises!

segments.text: Shout joyfully to YHWH, all the earth; break forth and cry aloud and sing praises!

verses.text: Sing praises to YHWH with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody!

segments.text: Sing praises to YHWH with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody!

verses.text: With the trumpets and the voice of the shofar, shout joyfully before the face of YHWH the King!

segments.text: With the trumpets and the voice of the shofar, shout joyfully before the face of YHWH the King!

verses.text: Let the sea roar, and its fullness, the world, and those dwelling in it!

segments.text: Let the sea roar, and its fullness, the world, and those dwelling in it!

verses.text: Let the rivers clap the hands; let the hills cry aloud together,

segments.text: Let the rivers clap the hands; let the hills cry aloud together,

verses.text: before the face of YHWH—for He is coming to judge the earth! He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with uprightness!
